 About the match
 On this page you can find the Villarreal vs Paris-SG match lineup for UEFA Champions League — Round 4, on Tuesday 03-11-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Villarreal lines up in a 4-4-2 led by Comesana, while Paris-SG sets up in a 4-3-3 led by Hakimi. Villarreal is led by head coach Iñigo Pérez, while Paris-SG is managed by Luis Enrique. The match is played at Estadio de la Ceramica.
